title: PoppyBrowserSessionRequest
description: PAP 0.3 browser form POST. The browser supplies its __Host- join cookie. code is single-use, at least 128 random bits, expires within 60 seconds and is read only from the own browser endpoint page. proof is a Session-key DPoP JWS with nonce=code, htm=POST, htu=endpoint and no ath. Runtime verification is mandatory.

proof.description: Compact signed JWS. Structural validation is not signature verification.
